name: Magnetic Flux Chamber
promptTemplate: Magnetic field lines in {{palette}} with {{field_topology}} topology, {{filing_density}} iron filings, {{tracer_count}} traced flux lines, orbit speed {{orbit_speed}}, and flux reach {{flux_reach}}

field_topology.hint: Switch between dipole loops, curls, and pure repulsion

filing_density.hint: Adjust the sheer count of aligned iron needle streaks

tracer_count.hint: Streamlines emitted from each attendee's charge

orbit_speed.hint: Speed up the orbital charge dance

flux_reach.hint: Broaden the range and arc length of field curves

gallery.blurb: Magnetic field lines: iron-filing streaks and traced field lines around several moving charges, one charge per person in their colour, the lines bending as the charges orbit.
gallery.prompt: Magnetic field lines: iron-filing streaks and traced field lines around several moving charges, one charge per person in their colour, the lines bending as the charges orbit. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
